title: Plot Wars on the Ashcombe Allotments
blurb: The Ashcombe allotment committee has been locked in a slow war over compost, shade and the correct way to stake a bean.

text.intro:
The Ashcombe allotment committee has been locked in a slow war over compost, shade and the correct way to stake a bean.
Five plot-holders are involved. Determine each plot-holder's placing, crop, plot and shed.
- **Plot-holder**: Ewan, Senga, Obadiah, Alphonse and Kasimir.
- **Placing** (listed from better to worse): first, second, third, fourth and fifth.
- **Prize crop**: a cauliflower, a runner bean, a row of leeks, a rhubarb crown and a marrow.
- **Plot**: plot 31, plot 11, plot 7, plot 2 and plot 19.
- **Shed**: a tar-paper shed, a corrugated lean-to, a greenhouse, an upturned boat and a brick bothy.
Every plot-holder has a different placing, crop, plot and shed, so within each category every item is used exactly once.
clues: At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The plot-holder who keeps an upturned boat and second are exactly one place apart in placing order, in one direction or the other. (b) The plot-holder who works plot 31 and fourth are exactly two places apart in placing order.
One of Obadiah and second sits at an odd-numbered placing and the other at an even-numbered placing.
Kasimir and fourth are exactly one place apart in placing order, in one direction or the other.
The plot-holder who keeps an upturned boat places second.
The plot-holder who keeps a tar-paper shed places third.
The plot-holder who grows a marrow is better than fourth in placing order.
Ewan does not grow a rhubarb crown. The plot-holder who grows a cauliflower falls somewhere between Ewan and first in placing order, matching neither.

The plot-holder who works plot 19 is worse than third in placing order. Senga falls somewhere between the plot-holder who works plot 19 and the plot-holder who works plot 2 in placing order, matching neither.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) Senga and the plot-holder who keeps a corrugated lean-to are exactly one place apart in placing order, in one direction or the other. (b) The plot-holder who grows a row of leeks and the plot-holder who keeps a brick bothy both sit at odd-numbered places or both at even-numbered places.
The plot-holder who grows a marrow and the plot-holder who keeps a brick bothy are exactly one place apart in placing order, in one direction or the other.
The plot-holder who works plot 7 and the plot-holder who keeps a corrugated lean-to are exactly one place apart in placing order, in one direction or the other.
The plot-holder who grows a runner bean and the plot-holder who works plot 31 are exactly one place apart in placing order, in one direction or the other.
Obadiah and the plot-holder who keeps a greenhouse are exactly two places apart in placing order.
